name: cyp
description: Checks a Markdown proof step by step with Rocq and colours it in the editor

cyp.command.description: The command that runs cyp (the driver, in an opam switch with Elpi 4 and the cyp library; e.g. 'opam exec --switch=elpi4 -- env CYP_LIB=/path/to/cyp/vernac cyp'); the options --json and the file name are added at the end.

cyp.checkOnSave.description: Check a cyp proof each time it is saved (a Markdown file that starts with a front matter holding 'require:' or 'by:').
